name: Heidy Sánchez (Bogotá councillor, Pacto Histórico)
detail: Her post listed Bill 477's changes ('a las grandes fortunas les suben el umbral del impuesto al patrimonio ... y lo eliminan desde 2031') without stating a position on the tax.

name: Ana Erazo (Representative, Pacto Histórico)
detail: Her quoted words in La Nación (10 Aug 2026) concern who benefits from the new government, not the wealth tax itself.

name: Alejandro Ocampo (Senator, Pacto Histórico)
detail: Quoted on Bill 477 only about VAT, the extraordinary powers (article 7) and the tax burden on the poor; nothing found on the wealth tax.

name: Gustavo Bolívar and Alfredo Mondragón on Bill 477
detail: Quoted about VAT on food and workers' taxes ('le baja los impuestos a los superricos'), not the wealth tax by name.

name: Vote for Ley 2277 de 2022 as a package (ponentes and members who voted yes)
detail: The reform has many taxes; a package vote or a ponencia for the whole bill is not specific to the wealth tax (arts. 35-37). The roll calls on the wealth-tax articles were not found.

name: Paloma Valencia (2026 presidential candidate)
detail: Her tax proposal included eliminating the wealth tax.
